sentences.text:
V.
 Shri A.R.Ben, Dy. G.A. for respondent/State.

Order
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.322/2024 dated 01.05.2024 registered at Police Station - Nagod, District - Satna (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

Applicant is in detention since 02.05.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, on 01.05.2024 major prosecutrix lodged F.I.R stating that she is student of B.A IIIrd year and knew Nitul Kushwaha.
It was further alleged that since 25.08.2021 to 19.01.2024 applicant committed rape upon her on the false promise of marriage.
FIR was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Applicant and prosecutrix both are major.
They were having consensual sexual relations for almost last three years and now when relationship is not working, prosecutrix has lodged false F.I.R just to 2 MCRC-23296-2024 pressurize him.
It is further submitted that even after alleged last incident of relationship, F.I.R has been lodged almost after three months.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant - Nitul Kushwaha be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand o nly ) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
